summary: LBW Business + Wealth Advisors is a Geelong West accounting, audit and wealth firm with a Melbourne CBD office, led by Principals including Simon Flowers and Leigh Harry. It is growing and recruiting graduates whose duties include bank, debtor and creditor reconciliations across Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks files. Simon mentors younger accountants and chairs the National CPA Public Practice Committee.

hooks.text: Graduate accountant ad lists bank, debtor and creditor reconciliations across Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks, and Simon cares about developing younger accountants: automation lets graduates reach advisory work sooner.

risks.text: Compliance, audit and wealth-led firm; no explicit bookkeeping or CFO offering seen, so fit is moderate to weak.
Simon's recent public profile is about community leadership and CPA committee work, not technology or automation.
Headcount sources conflict (LinkedIn 44 employees versus older job ads saying over 70 staff).

gaps: No podcast, video, Facebook or Instagram content found for Simon Flowers or Leigh Harry.
No statement found from LBW on AI or automation tools; tech stack inferred only from job ad and LinkedIn summary.
No named reconciliation or practice-management tools (Karbon, Dext etc.) found.
No LBW news coverage from 2025-2026 found beyond LinkedIn and own blog.
